overview: You marked Thursday the twentieth of February, and Shrove Tuesday the fourth of March. You did not mark a third afternoon. The want of four was said at the table. The almanac shows the two days you were willing to name.

parties.name: John Heminges
parties.context: Stood at the table while the marks went in. His face is not on the page.

assets.name: the almanac
assets.disposition: Marked the twentieth and Shrove Tuesday
